import json, time, importlib.util, sys
from collections import deque, defaultdict
from itertools import chain, groupby
from operator import itemgetter
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("m", "/workspace/submission/main.py")
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m)

def setup(fn):
    obj = json.load(open(fn))
    services = obj["services"]; rules = obj["rules"]
    si = {s: i for i, s in enumerate(services)}
    atoms = m.collect_atoms(rules)
    mons = [m.build_monitor(op, p, si, len(services))[0] for op, p in atoms]
    states, trans = m.build_product(mons, len(services))
    finals = [len(p) for (op, p) in atoms]
    accept = [all(st[i] == finals[i] for i in range(len(atoms))) for st in states]
    return len(states), len(services), trans, accept

def variants(n, k, trans, accept, use_active=False, use_aff=False, use_dist=False):
    t0 = time.time()
    rev = []
    active = []
    for a in range(k):
        column = list(map(itemgetter(a), trans))
        buckets = defaultdict(list)
        for source, target in enumerate(column):
            buckets[target].append(source)
        rev.append(buckets)
        active.append({t for t, v in buckets.items() if v})
    t_rev = time.time() - t0

    t0 = time.time()
    if use_dist:
        # distance BFS
        dist = [None]*n
        q = deque()
        for s in range(n):
            if accept[s]:
                dist[s] = 0; q.append(s)
        while q:
            u = q.popleft()
            d = dist[u] + 1
            for a in range(k):
                for v in rev[a][u]:
                    if dist[v] is None:
                        dist[v] = d
                        q.append(v)
        groups = {}
        for s in range(n):
            groups.setdefault(dist[s], []).append(s)
        blocks = [set(v) for v in groups.values()]
        class_of = [0]*n
        for pos, blk in enumerate(blocks):
            for s in blk:
                class_of[s] = pos
    else:
        class_of = [0]*n
        accepting = {s for s in range(n) if accept[s]}
        rejecting = set(range(n)) - accepting
        blocks = []
        if accepting: blocks.append(accepting)
        if rejecting: blocks.append(rejecting)
        for pos, blk in enumerate(blocks):
            for s in blk: class_of[s] = pos
    t_init = time.time() - t0

    t0 = time.time()
    class_key = class_of.__getitem__
    queue = deque(range(len(blocks))); queued = set(queue)
    stats = [0, 0, 0]
    while queue:
        bid = queue.popleft(); queued.discard(bid)
        splitter = blocks[bid]
        if not splitter: continue
        for a in range(k):
            if use_active:
                if splitter.isdisjoint(active[a]): continue
            sources = rev[a]
            movers = set(chain.from_iterable(map(sources.__getitem__, splitter)))
            if not movers: continue
            stats[0] += 1; stats[1] += len(movers)
            if use_aff:
                for cls in set(map(class_key, movers)):
                    block = blocks[cls]
                    moved = block & movers
                    if not moved or len(moved) == len(block): continue
                    stats[2] += 1
                    stay = block - moved
                    fresh = len(blocks); blocks.append(moved); blocks[cls] = stay
                    for s in moved: class_of[s] = fresh
                    if cls in queued:
                        queued.add(fresh); queue.append(fresh)
                    elif len(moved) <= len(stay):
                        queued.add(fresh); queue.append(fresh)
                    else:
                        queued.add(cls); queue.append(cls)
            else:
                ordered = sorted(movers, key=class_key)
                for cls, group in groupby(ordered, class_key):
                    moved = set(group)
                    block = blocks[cls]
                    if len(moved) == len(block): continue
                    stats[2] += 1
                    stay = block - moved
                    fresh = len(blocks); blocks.append(moved); blocks[cls] = stay
                    for s in moved: class_of[s] = fresh
                    if cls in queued:
                        queued.add(fresh); queue.append(fresh)
                    elif len(moved) <= len(stay):
                        queued.add(fresh); queue.append(fresh)
                    else:
                        queued.add(cls); queue.append(cls)
    t_main = time.time() - t0
    return t_rev, t_init, t_main, len(set(class_of)), stats

if __name__ == "__main__":
    for fn in sys.argv[1:]:
        n, k, trans, accept = setup(fn)
        print("== %s n=%d k=%d" % (fn, n, k))
        for name, kw in [("sort+groupby", {}),
                         ("+active", dict(use_active=True)),
                         ("aff", dict(use_aff=True)),
                         ("aff+active", dict(use_aff=True, use_active=True)),
                         ("aff+active+dist", dict(use_aff=True, use_active=True, use_dist=True)),
                         ("sort+active+dist", dict(use_active=True, use_dist=True))]:
            t = variants(n, k, trans, accept, **kw)
            print("  %-18s rev=%.3f init=%.3f main=%.3f total=%.3f classes=%d stats=%s" % (
                name, t[0], t[1], t[2], t[0]+t[1]+t[2], t[3], t[4]))
